kurz: Cook vegetables briefly in boiling salted water and stop them at once in iced water. They stay crisp and bright green.
bild_im_kopf: Like a photo taken at exactly the right moment: the iced water captures the best state.
was_passiert: The boiling water cooks the surface quickly, loosens some glue and drives out air, so the green glows. The iced water stops [[nachgaren|carry-over cooking]] immediately, before acids dull the green and the cells get too soft.
schritte: Salt plenty of water well and bring it to a rolling boil.
Have a bowl of iced water ready next to it.
Cook the vegetables in batches for 1–3 minutes.
Straight into the iced water until fully cold.
